faqs.q: How are margin and markup calculated?
faqs.a: Gross profit = Price − Cost. Margin% = Gross profit ÷ Price × 100. Markup% = Gross profit ÷ Cost × 100 (when cost > 0).

faqs.q: What is the difference between margin and markup?
faqs.a: Margin is profit as a share of selling price. Markup is profit as a share of cost. A 50% margin is not the same as a 50% markup.

faqs.q: Is this profit margin calculator AI-powered?
faqs.a: No. It uses only deterministic arithmetic so you always know how the percentages were derived.

faqs.q: Who should use a profit margin calculator?
faqs.a: Ecommerce sellers, wholesalers, service businesses, and anyone setting or reviewing list prices against cost of goods.

faqs.q: Does this include shipping, ads, or fees?
faqs.a: This tool focuses on cost vs price. For full landed profitability, use the Ecommerce Profit, Amazon FBA, Etsy, or eBay calculators.
